episode_summary: Brenton Miebach shares his journey of building a successful real estate business in new markets using AI and paid leads. He discusses the importance of mastering market knowledge, leveraging AI for operational efficiency, and using historical content to grow a social media presence. The episode provides actionable insights for agents looking to scale their business and improve productivity.
